==Description==
'''Null Engineer Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 14 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{GumDrops|315}} or {{Robux|39}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|2,105}} or {{Robux|626}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|44}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|791}}.

==Appearance==
'''Null Engineer Charm''' appearance is based on the {{Color|Null|Ghost}} [[Engineer]] and [[War Machine Sentry]]. It has {{Color|Null|Ghost}} [[Engineer]] standing on a platform with a few spikes coming out of it. It can be seen summoning in a {{Color|Null|Ghost}} [[War Machine Sentry]]. Black and purple smoke comes out of the charm.

The color of '''Null Engineer Charm''' depends on the username color of the player in the chat, though it is purple in its inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*Despite being named '''Null Engineer Charm''', it is not actually based on the [[Null Engineer]] seen in [[Blind Faith]]. It is instead based on the {{Color|Null|Ghost}} [[Engineer]] skin.
